snippet.title: Ariokan™ Release Trailer (English)
snippet.description:
✔️Buy on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3833620/Ariokan__create_your_cards_break_the_Meta/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=organicsocial&utm_campaign=trailer&utm_term=release

✔️Play the demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4050200/Ariokan_Demo/

✔️Join our community on Discord: https://discord.gg/wRyrpXvAdc

✔️Buy on Epic: https://store.epicgames.com/p/ariokan-536e54

Ariokan™ is a highly interactive, strategically-deep competitive card game with a twist: you can create new cards, and use them to build crazy combos around Gods and Legends to break the Meta.
No floodgates, no 10-minutes turns, no pay-to-win.
You can unlock cards created by other players too!

#Ariokan #collectiblecardgame #gameplay #trailer #steamgame #steam
